svg.title: Apache Doris service-based architecture
svg.desc: Service-based architecture for Apache Doris: two coarse-grained separately deployed service roles — Frontend (FE) and Backend (BE) — with clear responsibilities, horizontal scalability, and shared storage.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do clients connect to Apache Doris?')

g.text: Separately deployed, horizontally scalable — stateless query layer + stateful metadata

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does FE parse SQL in Apache Doris?')
sendPrompt('How does FE do query planning and optimization?')
sendPrompt('What metadata does FE manage in Doris?')
sendPrompt('How does FE manage BE nodes?')

svg.text: FE roles: Leader (writes metadata, Bdbje consensus) · Follower · Observer
User requests, SQL parsing, query planning, metadata management, node management

g.text: Separately deployed, horizontally scalable — storage-compute integrated

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does BE execute distributed query fragments?')
sendPrompt('What storage engine does Apache Doris BE use?')
sendPrompt('How does BE handle data ingestion in Doris?')
sendPrompt('How does BE manage tablet replicas?')

svg.text: Data storage and distributed query execution
Scale out independently — each BE owns tablet replicas on local disk

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does Apache Doris store data — local disk or object storage?')
g.text: Local disk per BE node (or object store in compute-storage separation mode)
